remote_source_commit_message: Add Agent Wall disconnect reconnect recovery
implementation_intent: The Rust/Ratatui TUI remains a projection-only LetterBlack/LBE frontend. Read-only Batch 1 and disconnect/reconnect recovery are accepted. Request/event correlation is not yet sufficient at the event/reducer boundary, so the read/write gate remains closed.

disconnect_reconnect_recovery.behavior: disconnect leaves live-connected state; reconnect re-runs the full four-projection chain through an isolated candidate and atomically replaces authority only after full success; failures remain non-Connected with no mock fallback

confirmed_gaps: tool lifecycle events lack explicit owning execution_id
command lifecycle events lack explicit owning execution_id
App reducer applies several request-specific events without an owning execution/proposal guard
mock approval identity is reused across independent proposal lifecycles
SnapshotUpdated is not a substitute for request ownership
RuntimeAttachmentUpdated is attachment state only, not request completion proof

active_operation_feedback_v1.current_behavior: Phase::Running currently shows the static composer text '> Execution in progress…'. Timed redraw infrastructure and intro animation already exist, but there is no general animated loading/progress indicator for long-running operations.
active_operation_feedback_v1.problem: During slow operations the terminal can appear visually idle or hung even though work is active.
active_operation_feedback_v1.goal: Provide state-driven animated activity feedback so users can distinguish active work from a frozen or broken UI.
active_operation_feedback_v1.design_rule: Animation must reflect real state only; do not fake percentage progress or claim work that is not actually active.
active_operation_feedback_v1.implementation_order: Implement after REQUEST_EVENT_CORRELATION_CONTRACT_V1 so event ownership changes and visual feedback remain separate patches.

upcoming_plan.scope: add explicit execution/proposal ownership to affected events, unique proposal approval IDs, and fail-closed reducer guards for stale/foreign events
prove stale-event, cross-execution, approval replay and terminal idempotency invariants
state-driven spinner/activity feedback for connecting, reconnecting, running and other long operations without fabricated progress

already_proven: zero mock fallback across implemented real read-only/recovery paths
read_write_gate.note: Passing correlation acceptance makes the gate eligible for separate review; it does not automatically open mutation authority.
